enchantments.tooltip: +14 Enhancement Bonus: +14 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Poisonous 6: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to drip with a vile venom, dealing 6d6 poison damage on each hit.
Critical Befouling 3: This deadly weapon saps the charm from your enemies, dealing 3 Charisma damage on each critical hit.
Doubleshot 8%: Passive: 8% Enhancement bonus to Doubleshot. (Doubleshot is a chance to score an additional hit with a ranged attack.)
Keen: Passive: The base critical threat range of this weapon is doubled. This does not stack with Improved Critical feat. Vorpal Strikes by this weapon also bypass all Fortification.
